summary.text: Jason Dockter is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 7 (home city listed as Bismarck), serving since 2013 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Dockter lists an occupation of Small Business Owner.
It lists education as BA, Economics, UND.
It also lists ND Army National Guard.
Family is listed as: Married (Brenda); 6 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Dockter's standing committee assignments as Energy and Natural Resources and Finance and Taxation.
